# Porn Recovery Knowledge Platform

An educational platform about problematic pornography use and recovery. All community
experience records are de-identified and labeled; they are reports, not scientific
evidence. Editorial analysis pages state opinions explicitly and keep evidence
boundaries. This site is not medical advice.

## Core sections

- Start: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/start/ — orientation for people who want to stop
- Problems (FAQ): https://selfcontrolatlas.com/problems/ — 45 answered questions with short answers
- Experiences: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/experiences/ — 124 de-identified community records
- Patterns: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/patterns/ — 12 recurring community patterns
- Triggers: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/triggers/ — 22 documented triggers
- Strategies: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/strategies/ — 16 strategies with evidence ratings
- Recovery stages: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/recovery/ — community-reported timeline, framed as reported, not biological
- Statistics: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/statistics/ — live aggregation, community sample, excludes synthetic records
- Analysis: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/analysis/ — editorial deep-dives (opinions labeled; statistics verifiable)

## Editorial analysis essays

- The Shape of Recovery: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/analysis/ — 124-account overview
- Long-Term Success: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/analysis/long-term-success/
- The Night Shift: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/analysis/nighttime/
- Relapse, Read Carefully: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/analysis/relapse/
- The First Week: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/analysis/early-days/
- What the Accounts Use: https://selfcontrolatlas.com/analysis/strategies/
